persona.name: Tara Lindholm

personality.description: This person tends to stick with familiar routines and proven methods, preferring practical, conventional approaches over experimentation. They are moderately organized, keeping enough structure to stay on track while still adapting when needed, and they usually bring high energy and warmth into social settings. In moral dilemmas, they are likely to weigh the impact on others carefully, seek a cooperative solution, and avoid choices that would create unnecessary tension or harm group harmony. In group discussions, they speak freely, encourage participation, and use a friendly, reassuring tone, while remaining calm and steady even if the conversation becomes stressful.
traits: asks for clarification rather than assuming
gives an opinion when asked, briefly
goes along with a decision they did not personally push for

style.influence: Participates without trying to run the room. Contributes when they have something to add and is content to let others set direction.

relationships.name: family
relationships.description: Has children; family commitments sit outside work and occasionally cut into it.

speech_examples: Can you say more about that?
I'm not sure we've ruled out the other option.
